Steps to reproduce:

Tried to archive an email coming from PayPal using the "Archive" button in menu bar or "Archive" in context menu.

Actual results:

Both, "Archive" button and "Archive" entry in context menu are missing.

Expected results:

It's possible to archive any other email. These "Archive" entries are only missing at emails from PayPal, as far as I noticed.
